purpose: Machine-readable definitions for public Flow World tools that an AI can understand and reproduce without a server API.

b.description: Non-empty finite numeric list with the same length as a.

preconditions: a and b have the same length
boundary: Does not decide which side is better without an external objective.

operation: Read only the URL fragment after #.
Render a small safe Markdown subset locally in the browser.
Do not send or persist the payload server-side.
boundary: Only markdown is supported in v0.
Raw HTML is escaped and not executed.
The fragment may remain visible in browser history or be shared with the URL; do not place secrets in it.

compatibility.read_only_ai: supported for URL construction if Base64URL encoding is available; opening/rendering may be delegated to the human

tools.mechanism: AI-readable exploration and observation protocol; UI is optional and does not provide browser access by itself.
action_options: switch-button selection and subsequent return/continue choice
operation: Keep parent_target and new_interest distinct; use the action options relevant to the current request. They are independent, not a required sequence.
Use attributable evidence already available. AI may choose and execute its own authorized trials; identify the actor and method.
If a human-specific observation is missing, leave it unknown and continue useful exploration. Request a minimal human answer or action only when essential to the requested outcome.
Classify results by source: UI event, human report, AI execution, external action, or simulated example. Keep interpretations and hypotheses separate from observations.
Record what each source establishes. AI trials or simulations do not establish human choices; button events and reports do not by themselves independently verify real-world task changes.
Return a report of available results and limits to the parent question. Missing evidence for one option does not block the rest of the report.

output.status: observed, partial, or awaiting_evidence when essential evidence blocks the requested outcome
output.evidence_source: ui_event, human_report, ai_execution, external_action, simulated_example, or none; identify actor and method
output.supported_fact: what actual evidence establishes; simulations are examples, not observed human facts
output.real_world_task_state: unknown unless supported by separate action evidence
output.interpretation: AI may add explicitly labeled interpretation or hypothesis outside the instrument observation

boundary: Describe, inspect, execute, or adapt the tool as useful to the request; do not claim execution when it was only described.
A UI click establishes the click, not completion of the named activity.
A human report establishes what was reported, not independent verification.
Do not present inferred motive, true purpose, value, personality, or stable tendencies as observed facts. Any relevant interpretation remains explicitly labeled and tentative.
FIRST MOVE is the first selection within that card after START, not necessarily the first real-world action.

compatibility.read_only_ai: supported as a conversational protocol; may analyze, propose AI trials, and report partial results without human input; cannot claim unobserved clicks or human actions
compatibility.javascript_ai: can inspect or reproduce the protocol; does not gain browser access automatically
compatibility.browser_operator: can use #switch-lab UI when browser controls are actually available

execution_preference: reproduce deterministic operation from this file
use shared JavaScript implementation when executable
use human browser UI only when interaction is available
compatibility_policy.unavailable_capability_rule: Report the unavailable step, use a suitable alternative when possible, and continue other authorized work. Ask for human interaction only when essential to the requested outcome.

shapes.purpose: Carry current working coordinates to another AI or human without treating prior conclusions as authority.
boundary: This is a shape, not an automated judgment tool.
Packet contents must be re-evaluated against current evidence on re-entry.
Do not write personal packet contents into the public core automatically.

optional_flow_layer.purpose: Preserve the minimum movement needed to avoid turning the packet into a static parts list.
boundary: Do not use it as a retrospective narrative.
Do not promote prior interpretation to authority.
